verdict.rationale: PayPal provides webhooks for event notifications (including subscription/payment events) and an Agent Toolkit that lets AI agents call PayPal APIs via function calling, which could be assembled into a failed-payment monitoring/retry workflow. However, there is no explicit evidence of built-in dunning management, automated retry logic, or failed-payment-specific tooling—an agent would need to build this logic itself on top of generic webhook/API primitives.
